chapter: Desvigne compared; Piron, Celestin and rivals
title: Desvigne's band compared to Basie; Joe Newman, Earl Bostic
summary: He judges Desvigne's musicians equal to Basie's; Joe Newman and Earl Bostic were hometown players.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: I never did get to hear it. I might have heard the band once. Oh, 1942 or something. When I first was around here. But how did it compare? I mean, it might be difficult for you to judge yourself if you were playing in it. But how did it compare, say, with Count Basie or Lunsford or some of those other big bands? Did it seem as powerful and as big as... Well, at the time...

How did it compare, do you think? At the time, I think the band compared as powerful as Count Basie's band at the time because they had a lot of young musicians in it and a lot of good ones. And they could play. They could blow. And to me, the musician was just as good as any musician you could find anywhere in the world. Just as good as musicians you could find in Count Basie. Maybe Basie might have been playing a different type of music. Or might have been playing a little fast or something like that. But as far as the musicianship and the playing, Sidney had just as good as musicians you could find anywhere in the world. Sidney had musicians that could sit in anybody's band. That could leave Sidney's band and go to Count Basie. And I guess Basie had members of his band and leave his band and come to Sidney. That's how good the musicians were. So that's the only way I could compare them. You had just as good as musicians in Sidney's band as Count Basie had in his band. You had a lot of wonderful musicians that could blow you a lot of horn, play you a lot of music. And your dad had bands in Sidney's band that left here, was playing right here, and left here and wasn't joining Basie like Joe Newman. That's right, yeah. Joe Newman was a hometown boy, played around here with us. He left here and played some small bands around there. He left here and went to North State up there with me. I guess if he had been a piece of so long, he wouldn't know how to play with all the bands. Yeah.
See, Earl Bostic, the saxophonist, did he ever play with you or with Sidney Diasbeen or other groups? I know he was here for a while.

Basie played here, but Basie didn't play with Sidney. But when he played with Sidney, I wasn't in the band. Tip된 stuff there with된 stuff there with된 stuff there with된 stuff there with된 stuff there with된

But he was a wonderful musician, the best he got. Well he's a hometown boy, was born and raised here. He left here and went up, been on his own ever since. He had his own band. Bosky is a New Orleans musician. Just like I say, he could play just as good or better as a musician anywhere in the world. And he improved himself. He's a wonderful musician, Bosky.
